perplexity.description:
NOW 80s Alternative is a 2023 compilation album released by Sony Music and EMI, featuring a curated selection of 30 tracks across two pink vinyl LPs or an 80-track 4CD set. The album showcases the breadth of alternative music from the 1980s, spanning genres such as electronic, rock, and pop. Artists represented include New Order, Eurythmics, Joy Division, The Smiths, The Psychedelic Furs, David Sylvian, and The Pixies, among others. The tracklist highlights seminal hits and cult favorites, reflecting the era’s experimental spirit and genre-blurring creativity, with notable inclusions like David Sylvian’s “Red Guitar” and “Pop Song,” as well as Japan’s “Gentleman Take Polaroids (edit).”

As part of the long-running Now That’s What I Call Music! series, NOW 80s Alternative stands out for its focus on the alternative and post-punk movements of the decade, offering a snapshot of the period’s most influential and innovative sounds. The compilation does not represent a new artistic statement by any single artist but serves as a retrospective celebration of the era’s alternative scene, contextualizing key tracks within the broader evolution of 1980s popular music. Upon release, the album was well-received by fans and critics for its thoughtful curation and high-quality presentation, particularly praised for its vinyl pressing and the inclusion of rare or lesser-known tracks alongside major hits.
